_comment: Shamir compatibility vectors for the KySecurity suite. SplitSecret draws fresh randomness per call, so split output is not reproducible from a seed; the contract these vectors fix is the combine direction. Any implementation claiming compatibility must reconstruct secret_hex from these exact shares. Generated once from kysignon-server's implementation and verified to round-trip under ky_server_base's before being frozen. A change that breaks a vector is a breaking change.
